description: Career profile from shot-level charting data, summed over the player's charted matches. Serve placement (deuce/ad x wide/body/T), return depth and outcomes, net play, and clutch break/game/set-point serving. Also winners and errors by wing, and rally-length tendencies. COVERAGE IS CURATED, not full-slate: 11,646 charted matches back to the 1960s, concentrated on the majors. An ambiguous name returns the candidates to choose from. Requires the ULTRA plan.

gender.description: Disambiguates a name charted on both tours.

name.description: Player name fragment, min 3 chars. Must resolve to one charted person.

name: get_charting_player

coverage.description: A reminder that charting coverage is curated, not full-slate.

families.description: Per-family summed numeric columns: raw sums over the player's charted Total rows.

matches_charted.description: The sample every summed field covers.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.
